summary: Finalized SCH-02 test coverage by adding traceable test specification and integration rollback coverage. Added tests/specs/SCH-02.md mapping SCH-02 acceptance criteria to explicit deterministic cases. Extended tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig with TC-SCH-02-03 to prove transaction rollback behavior keeps timer status pending when TIMER_FIRED append fails. Existing SCH-02 integration tests already cover due selection, advisory-lock skip behavior, atomic fired+event append, and cancellation compatibility.
